tickerText: [TENNIS] Rolex Shanghai Masters first-round play rolls on Oct. 8 while Alexander Zverev preps to open against Wu Yibing after Novak Djokovic lifted his seventh China Open; Iga Swiatek faces Elise Mertens in Beijing quarters chasing a WTA Finals berth • [SQUASH] CIB Egyptian Squash Open qualifying closes at OWest with men's and women's finals deciding the last main-draw spots before the Pyramids glass court hosts the PSA Diamond from Oct. 10 • [BADMINTON] Arctic Open round of 16 in Vantaa: Lee Zii Jia beat Dong Tian Yao 21-18, 21-14 and the men's field narrows toward quarterfinals with Li Shi Feng, Anders Antonsen, and Kunlavut Vitidsarn in the mix • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Chicago Cup pro round of 16 Thursday indoors at Life Time Northbrook—1,500-point Cup with FS1 and PickleballTV from 2 p.m. CT as Anna Leigh Waters eyes career title No. 200 • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT China Smash last-16 day in Beijing: Felix Lebrun meets Tomislav Pucar, Wang Manyu faces Shin Yubin, and Sun Yingsha advanced past Orawan Paranan in five after the round of 32

newsItems.title: Chicago Cup Reaches Round Of 16
newsItems.excerpt: The Veolia Chicago Cup's pro draw moves into the round of 16 Thursday at Life Time Northbrook, with 1,500 ranking points on the line and national TV on FS1 and PickleballTV.

newsItems.title: Egyptian Open Qualifying Finals
newsItems.excerpt: Qualifying at OWest wraps Oct. 8 with men's and women's finals after a bruising week of upsets, setting the last entrants before the Diamond event shifts to the Pyramids.

newsItems.title: Shanghai Masters Gets Underway
newsItems.excerpt: First-round matches opened the Rolex Shanghai Masters on Oct. 8 as Alexander Zverev turned toward Wu Yibing, fresh off a 58-15 season and still in the hunt for year-end No. 1.

newsItems.title: Arctic Open Hits Last 16
newsItems.excerpt: The BWF Super 500 in Vantaa moved into the round of 16 as Lee Zii Jia beat Dong Tian Yao in straight games and the singles draws tightened toward weekend quarterfinals.
